heading: What I'm building now
lead: At Particle41 I work on agentic developer tooling — systems where models do real engineering work inside a pipeline that can be trusted, measured, and repeated.

items.title: Agentic Software Factory
items.body: AI developer tooling that takes a product requirements document and generates a working application from it. The hard parts are orchestration across multiple agents, keeping generated code inside architectural guardrails, and building the evaluation loop that tells you whether the output is actually good.

items.title: AI summarization & Jira automation
items.body: Tooling that compresses planning and triage work — automated summarization plus Jira task generation and routing — cutting the manual overhead that sits between a requirement and a ticket a developer can pick up.

items.title: Multi-tenant SaaS backends
items.body: The other half of the job: leading backend architecture and delivery for Synemi and Nigel, directing a team of up to seven engineers and setting clean-architecture and test-coverage standards that hold up as the team grows.
